query: SELECT attr_val FROM (SELECT b.attr_val, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM attributes b JOIN products p ON b.ref_id = p.ref_id WHERE b.category = 'musical instruments' AND b.attr_key = 'Brand' GROUP BY b.attr_val HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.ref_id) >= 50) ORDER BY avg_price DESC, attr_val ASC LIMIT 1
